extracted_schemes.title: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Elderly, Widows, Persons with Disabilities
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 via direct DBT transfer
extracted_schemes.description: Flagship welfare programme providing direct monthly pension support to destitute elderly, widows and disabled individuals across India.

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Unbanked citizens and rural households
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Zero balance savings account with ₹2 lakh accident insurance & ₹10,000 overdraft
extracted_schemes.description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services, banking, savings, remittance and credit.

extracted_schemes.title: Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Land owners and rural citizens
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: 100% digital land records and unique parcel identification
extracted_schemes.description: Computerization of land records, cadastral maps, and transparency in land property rights.

extracted_schemes.title: Cabinet Approves Enhanced MUDRA Loan Limit to ₹20 Lakh Under Tarun Plus
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Small entrepreneurs and expanding micro-enterprises
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Credit limit doubled from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh without collateral
extracted_schemes.description: Union Cabinet approved enhancement of loan ceiling under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana for borrowers who previously repaid Tarun loans.

extracted_schemes.title: Expansion of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY to All Senior Citizens Aged 70+
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: All citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹5,00,000 free annual health coverage top-up per senior citizen
extracted_schemes.description: Universal health coverage rollout for every Indian citizen aged 70 and above with dedicated Ayushman Vay Vandana Cards.

extracted_schemes.title: PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana Approved with ₹75,021 Crore Outlay
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Residential urban and rural households
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Up to ₹78,000 subsidy for rooftop solar installation with 300 units free power
extracted_schemes.description: Initiative to provide free electricity to 1 crore households through rooftop solar systems with direct central subsidy.

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN DBT)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Small and marginal landholder farmer families
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹6,000 annually in three direct installments of ₹2,000 via Aadhaar payment bridge
extracted_schemes.description: Central sector DBT scheme providing continuous income support directly into bank accounts of verified farmers nationwide.

extracted_schemes.title: PAHAL (Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh) LPG Subsidy
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Domestic LPG consumers across India
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Direct subsidy credit into bank accounts for refill cylinders
extracted_schemes.description: World's largest cash transfer programme ensuring transparent transfer of cooking gas subsidies directly into consumer bank accounts.

extracted_schemes.title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS DBT)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: ITI graduates, diploma holders and apprentice trainees
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500/month directly paid by Central Government
extracted_schemes.description: Government directly transfers stipend subsidies to apprentices via DBT to boost industrial vocational apprenticeships.

extracted_schemes.title: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST Candidates
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Low income SC/ST students pursuing Masters and PhD abroad
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: 100% tuition fee reimbursement, annual contingency and travel allowance
extracted_schemes.description: Financial assistance to students from marginalized communities to pursue Masters and Doctoral studies in top global universities.

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Homeless families and households living in kutcha houses
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly areas + 90 days MGNREGA wages
extracted_schemes.description: Rural housing flagship scheme providing financial assistance for construction of pucca houses with hygienic cooking space.

extracted_schemes.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Meritorious Class 8 students from economically weaker sections
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹12,000 per annum from Class 9 to Class 12
extracted_schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship to prevent dropouts after middle school and support education up to secondary completion.

extracted_schemes.title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Women heads of eligible families in Tamil Nadu
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹1,000 monthly basic entitlement directly credited on the 15th of every month
extracted_schemes.description: Flagship Tamil Nadu entitlement scheme recognizing women's household labor and providing monthly universal basic income support.

extracted_schemes.title: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (Mudhalvarin Kaalai Unavu Thittam)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Primary school students (Classes 1 to 5) in all TN Government schools
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Free hot cooked nutritious breakfast on all school working days
extracted_schemes.description: Pioneering state scheme serving fresh hot breakfast to overcome malnutrition and boost classroom focus across 31,000+ schools.

extracted_schemes.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Puthumai Penn Scheme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Female students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in TN Government schools
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into bank account until course completion
extracted_schemes.description: Assistance scheme promoting female gross enrollment in higher education, preventing early marriages and reducing dropout rates.

extracted_schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Comprehensive Health Insurance (CMCHIS)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Families residing in Tamil Nadu with annual income under ₹1.2 lakh
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Cashless hospitalization up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
extracted_schemes.description: Comprehensive cashless insurance covering 1,000+ hospital treatments and critical surgeries across empaneled hospitals.

scraped_data_by_portal.source_name: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
scraped_data_by_portal.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

extracted_schemes.title: Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: State governments, panchayats, and rural communities
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Low-interest loans for rural roads, irrigation, bridges, and primary health centres
extracted_schemes.description: Dedicated infrastructure financing to state governments for creating rural connectivity, storage godowns, and agricultural markets.

extracted_schemes.title: NABARD SHG-Bank Linkage Programme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Women Self Help Groups (SHGs) across rural districts
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Collateral-free group loans with interest subvention at 7%
extracted_schemes.description: World's largest microfinance initiative linking unbanked rural women into creditworthy self-help groups for micro-enterprises.

extracted_schemes.title: Agri-Clinic and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) Scheme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Agriculture graduates and rural agro-entrepreneurs
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Composite subsidy up to 44% (women/SC/ST) and 36% (general) on project loans up to ₹20 lakh
extracted_schemes.description: Promotes agricultural ventures by agriculture graduates to provide expert extension services, soil testing, and inputs to farmers.

extracted_schemes.title: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: School children from pre-school to Class 12 across India
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Free textbooks, uniforms, ICT digital labs, and teacher training grants
extracted_schemes.description: Integrated scheme for school education ensuring equitable, inclusive and quality education aligned with National Education Policy (NEP).

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (PM-USHA)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: State universities and government colleges
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Institutional development grants up to ₹100 crore for state universities
extracted_schemes.description: Strategic funding for state higher educational institutions to improve quality, infrastructure, multidisciplinary research, and accreditations.

extracted_schemes.title: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) on Education Loans
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Students from families with annual income ≤ ₹4.5 lakh
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: 100% full interest waiver during course period plus one year moratorium
extracted_schemes.description: Full interest subsidy on bank education loans for students from economically weaker sections pursuing approved professional degree courses.

extracted_schemes.beneficiary: OBC, EBC, and Nomadic Tribe (DNT) students
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: ₹75,000/year for Class 9-10; ₹1,25,000/year for Class 11-12 in top designated schools
extracted_schemes.description: Top class school education scholarship scheme for other backward classes and marginalized youth awarded via national merit.

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)

extracted_schemes.description: Competency-based vocational skill training and upskilling for marginalized youth to secure wage employment or micro-enterprises.

extracted_schemes.title: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)

extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Concessional venture debt and equity financing from ₹20 lakh up to ₹15 crore
extracted_schemes.description: Promotes wealth creation and high-growth entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste founders in manufacturing and technology.

extracted_schemes.title: Mission Shakti - Sambal and Samarthya
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Women in distress, working mothers, and self-employed women
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: One Stop Centres (Sakhi), Working Women Hostels, and Palna day care creches
extracted_schemes.description: Integrated umbrella scheme dedicated to safety, security and economic empowerment of women across all life stages.

extracted_schemes.title: Mission Poshan 2.0 (Integrated Nutrition Support)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Children 0-6 years, adolescent girls, and pregnant/lactating mothers
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Fortified supplementary nutrition, growth monitoring, and hot meals via Anganwadis

scraped_data_by_portal.source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises

extracted_schemes.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, and traditional artisans
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Up to 35% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) & ₹20 lakh (services)
extracted_schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment ventures in non-farm sector across urban and rural locations.

extracted_schemes.title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: New and existing micro and small enterprises
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Collateral-free credit facility up to ₹5 crore with 75% to 85% government guarantee
extracted_schemes.description: Enables first-generation entrepreneurs to access term loans and working capital without having to pledge immovable property as security.

extracted_schemes.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Artisans and craftspeople across 18 traditional family trades
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest + ₹15,000 toolkit voucher
extracted_schemes.description: Comprehensive support scheme providing skill certification, toolkit incentives, digital transaction rewards and brand marketing to traditional artisans.

scraped_data_by_portal.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: All farmers growing notified food crops and oilseeds
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Comprehensive crop loss cover with nominal premium: 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial crops
extracted_schemes.description: Subsidized crop insurance protecting farmers against non-preventable natural risks, drought, floods, pests and unseasonal weather.

extracted_schemes.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs, and primary agri-credit societies
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: 3% interest subvention per annum on loans up to ₹2 crore for 7 years + credit guarantee
extracted_schemes.description: Medium-long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure, cold storage, silos, and community farm assets.

extracted_schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Cultivators, tenant farmers, animal husbandry, and fisheries farmers
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Short term crop credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest upon timely repayment
extracted_schemes.description: Timely access to affordable credit for purchase of agricultural inputs, seeds, fertilizers, livestock feeds and marketing expenses.

extracted_schemes.title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Rural poor women organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs)
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Revolving Fund ₹20,000-₹30,000 + CIF + interest subvention at 7% on loans up to ₹20 lakh
extracted_schemes.description: Alleviating rural poverty by building sustainable community institutions of women and enabling diversified livelihood options.

extracted_schemes.title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days wage employment per financial year with direct bank credit
extracted_schemes.description: Social security safety net providing guaranteed wage employment while creating durable village assets, water conservation and farm ponds.

extracted_schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
extracted_schemes.beneficiary: Rural habitations and village communities
extracted_schemes.benefit_details: All-weather road connectivity connecting unreached rural habitations to market centres
extracted_schemes.description: Nationwide programme constructing durable, paved all-weather roads to connect remote rural villages to highways and healthcare centres.
